versions.changelog:
AI Earrings Designer initial release:

- Generates custom earrings designs from prompts and reference images, supporting gemstones, metals, shapes, and materials.
- Creates hand-drawn design sheets, multiview sketches, and interactive 3D jewelry viewer.
- Offers API endpoints for generating jewelry design drafts and hand-drawn sketches.
- Integrates with OneKey Agent Gateway for secure API access.
- Supports multiple jewelry types beyond earrings, including bracelets, rings, necklaces, and more.
